title: Retractable hooks and garment rod Wall Mount 2-Inch Solid Brass Hook, 15 lb Capacity, Modern Style Allied Brass
description:
Add space-saving storage with a retractable hooks and garment rod built for modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories. This wall mount solid brass hook extends for 2-1/2" of hanging space, then retracts to sit close to the wall—ideal for minimalist bathroom fixtures.

Highlights:
- Retractable rod: 2-1/2" hanging space when pulled out
- Capacity: holds up to 15 lb
- Wall mount design helps keep pathways clear and saves floor space
- Customizable look: remove the supplied knob tip and swap in a cabinet knob of your choice
- Hardware included; fits standard interior walls

Specs:
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L; projection 1"
- Mounting hardware: 6/32 toggles
- Installation: requires drilling a 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around
- Assembly required: No
- Finish variety: available in 28 designer finishes (including statement options like unlacquered brass, antique pewter, fire engine red, pink, and autumn sparkle)

_previous.title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
